<infobox type="character">
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>
    <panel name="img">
        <section name="section1">
            <label>{{{skin1|Original Skin}}}</label>
			<image source="image1">
				  <default>{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} (Pose).png|{{PAGENAME}} (Pose).png|{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}}.png|{{PAGENAME}}.png|}}}}</default>
				  <caption source="caption1"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section2">
            <label>{{{skin2|Shiny Skin}}}</label>
				<image source="image2">
					<default>{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} Shiny.png|{{PAGENAME}} Shiny.png|}}}}</default>
					<caption source="caption2"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section3">
            <label>{{{skin3}}}</label>
				<image source="image3">
					<caption source="caption3"/>
				</image>
        </section>
   </panel>
  <data source="deployment_cost">
    <label>Deployment Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{deployment_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData|get|cost}}}}¥</span>|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="total_cost">
    <label>Total Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{total_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|total_cost}}}}¥</span>|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="upgrade_levels">
    <label>Upgrade Levels</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade_levels}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
    <data source="spawn_cap">
    <label>Spawn Cap</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|spawn_cap}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Tower_type">
    <label>Tower Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|tower_type}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Damage_type">
  	<label>Damage Type</label>
  	<format><span 
  	>{{#ifeq:{{{Damage_type}}}|true|{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|true_damage}}|{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|{{{Damage_type}}}}}}}</span></format>
  	<default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|base_damage_type}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Secondary_Damage_type">
  	<label>Secondary Damage Type</label>
  	<format><span 
  	>{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|{{{Secondary_Damage_type}}}_damage}}</span></format>
  	<default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|secondary_damage_types}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <group>
    <header>Attack Stats</header>
    <data source="Crit_Chance">
      <label>Crit Chance</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|crit_chance}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="Attack_Type">
      <label>Attack Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|attack_type}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="damage">
		<label>Damage</label>
		<format><span
		>{{formatnum:{{{damage}}}}}</span></format>
		<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData|get|damage}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|damage}}|{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|damage|max}}||-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|damage|max}} }}}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="seconds_per_attack">
      <label>Attack Rate</label>
      <default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData|get|attack_cooldown}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|attack_cooldown}}|{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}}||-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}} }}}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="range">
    	<label>Range</label>
    	<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData|get|range}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData|get|range}}|{{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|range|max}}||-> {{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData|get|upgrade|range|max}} }}}}|[[Category:UnitData error]]}}</default>
	</data>
  </group>
  <group>
    <header>About</header>
    <data source="release">
    	<label>Release</label>
	</data>
  </group>
</infobox>

<noinclude>
Example usage:
<pre>
{{Tower Infobox

  |caption1= "I don't need a reason to fight. I just 
  follow my instincts."

  |Damage_type= physical
  
  |Secondary_Damage_type= lightning_damage
  
  |deployment_cost= 1350
  
  |total_cost= 89300

  |upgrade_levels= 8
  
  |spawn_cap = 3

  |Tower_type= Ground
  
  |Crit_Chance = 50%
  
  |Attack_Type= AoE (Circle)

  |damage= 1950 -> 37500

  |seconds_per_attack= 8 -> 9

  |range= 15 -> 33

}}
</pre>

</templatedata>
</noinclude>
